blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas wrapped up its first-round campaign with back-to-back wins in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. As the Growling Tigers managed to stay in the middle of the pack with a 4-3 record, they are set to get a big boost with the impending return of key forward Gelo Crisostomo. In fact, Crisostomo told the Inquirer that he was even ready to suit up before UST’s 80-68 win over Ateneo at Quadricentennial Pavilion on Saturday. “Actually, I could’ve played today but the coaches told me to play […]...
